title: Chicken Piccata Risotto
reject_reason: Chicken in a lemon-caper-wine piccata sauce is the same dinner as live chicken-piccata-skillet (bge 0.926, shares butter/chicken/broth/olive-oil/parmesan); serving it over risotto is a starch swap on an existing piccata, and the piccata region is already crowded in backlog.
